title: Item Clear
description: A simple datapack that clears items more frequently. Good on server with many players
body:
# Item Clear
This datapack remove items all dropped items (items not picked up) every 30 seconds.

It is good for server with lag from items. If your server/smp thing has people that lag the 
game with items, this will help

**NOT RECOMMENDED WITH SURVIVAL AND NO KEEP INVENTORY**
